iti59:1.1: 10 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti59:2.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu atikkamma māradheyyaṃ ādiccova virocati
iti59:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asekkhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti asekkhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti asekkhena paññākkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
iti59:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu atikkamma māradheyyaṃ ādiccova virocatīti.
iti59:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
